notes.title: Christmas Update 2.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26112700/83f599d133ba2e5e670f94e833a8a54ea7d303f7.png[/img]

The magical Christmas update is live. 

You will find a new Spell Book filled with 6 new spells and 6 new exams! 

The main theme music has been replaced by a Christmas themed theme song. If you want to go back to the original music, you can do so in the options screen. 

The Christmas book is unlocked once you finish the first tutorial book.

notes.title: Halloween Update Progress Begins!
notes.content:
Work on the free Halloween update has begun.  A new spell book with 6 spells and 6 exams will be available in October!

The Halloween book will have a low to moderate difficulty, with at least one challenging spell.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26112700/297d9d13917d50d50a8917888e7599e499610051.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 2.1.0 Released! Now With Voice Overs!
notes.content:
Thanks to you wonderful people I was able to hire a voice actor to record the lines of Wizard Purrcival Floof.  His tutorial text is voiced and important events like passing or failing an exam now have voice lines.


[b]Patch Notes[/b]
- Added Voice Overs
- Tweaked Spell "Mend" to be a little easier

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26112700/3fc0393ab7ab8908803a7c2ad5c6476a7d02654b.gif[/img]
